Coram : M.B. SHAH*, R.P. SETHI
Freedom Fighters Pension Scheme, 1972 :· Pension-Application-Grant of from a subsequent date-Claim for grant from the date of application-But Government cancelling the grant of pension­ Held not justified-Appellant entitled to pension from the date of application­ However, in the first writ petition. Freedom fighter pension-Rejection of claim-On the ground of.failure A B c to prove the claim-Held, such claim is required to be determined on the basis D of probabilities-Not on the touchstone of test of 'beyond reasonable doubt' - A presumption is required to be drawn in
Decision Date : 25-09-2001 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6718/2001 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
